correctness.rationale: On the x²-chart, q=y²/x², r=z/x², and the integral generator t=y/x satisfies t²=q and xt=y. In characteristic two the normalized relation is r²+x²t²r+xt⁴+xt=0. Thus the normalization quotient is generated by [t], and x[t]=0; multiplying the relation by t gives r²t=x²qtr+xq²t+xq, which belongs to the original ring. Modulo x, the image of the original ring in k[t,r]/(r²) is k[t²,r]/(r²); its free odd summand proves that no further annihilator occurs. The ideal (x,r²) is the ideal of the scheme-theoretic inverse image of the singular point on this chart, since y=r² modulo x. The z-chart misses this fiber (the exceptional equation there reduces to 1=0), and the normalization is an isomorphism away from it. On the symmetric y²-chart the generator s=x/y satisfies [s]=q⁻¹[t], giving the pullback of O(-1) on the split ribbon, not a module on the reduced line. Tensoring the nilpotent filtration gives O(-2) and O(-1); their cohomology gives h¹=1. The frozen RESULT.md chart argument and VERIFICATION.md were checked algebraically, without executing software.
